description: This source file defines a structure for representing jobs to run hooks (HookJob) and an actor (HookExecutor) for executing hook commands asynchronously, with configuration, timeout, and environment setup.

classes.name: HookJob
classes.description: A struct representing a hook job containing text and timestamp.

classes.name: HookExecutor
classes.description: An actor responsible for executing hook commands with appropriate environment and timeout management.

methods.name: HookJob.init
methods.description: Initializes a HookJob with text and timestamp.

methods.name: HookExecutor.init
methods.description: Initializes the HookExecutor with a configuration object.

methods.name: HookExecutor.shouldRun
methods.description: Determines whether the hook should run based on cooldown settings.

methods.name: HookExecutor.run
methods.description: Executes the specified hook job asynchronously, handling process execution, environment setup, and timeout.
